items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: he was with us when Phil Dorsey called and told me he had a few dates

ctx.x: for him to go stay anywhere like he can. Well, you know it's all right but what about the neighbors with a white guy staying here. So I said to her, mama, you're talking like they talk now, they always say it's all right, but. So she finally said if you think you need him and it will be some help to you and it looks like you got carried away with that music, well go ahead, it's all right.

And so Dave stayed with us in our home. He had a room there. And then he went to work and then he was with us when Phil Dorsey called and told me he had a few dates and he said I got a date, several little dates in small towns in Kansas and a few in Nebraska, but I've got you in Colorado with a battle of bands with Smiling Billy Stewart. I had never heard about Billy Stewart, and Smiling Billy Stewart at that time had a twelve or fourteen piece band and he said it's going to be a battle of the bands, winner take…
